scope: Recoverable relocation of a completed, inactive generated fuzz build cache after the internal 20 GiB compile preflight failed. This is workspace hygiene, not model acceptance.
digest_method: From the fuzz directory: rg --files --hidden --no-ignore -0 target | LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256. The explicit root target path traverses the preserving symlink after relocation. The digest covers regular-file contents and relative names, not filesystem timestamps or permission metadata.
